description: This file contains automated test cases for RPM package management, including help, query, install, remove, and log verification tests, using a testing framework with dependencies and setup routines.

classes.name: RpmBasicTest
classes.description: Test case class for basic RPM command functionalities including help and query commands, and testing RPM operations as different users.

classes.name: RpmInstallRemoveTest
classes.description: Test case class for installing and removing RPM packages, and verifying RPM log entries.

methods.name: test_rpm_help
methods.description: Tests the 'rpm --help' command to verify RPM is accessible.

methods.name: test_rpm_query
methods.description: Checks if RPM database exists and queries the RPM package.

methods.name: test_rpm_query_nonroot
methods.description: Tests RPM commands executed as a different user, including user creation and deletion.

methods.name: set_up_test_user
methods.description: Creates a new test user if it does not exist.

methods.name: exec_as_test_user
methods.description: Executes RPM commands as the test user.

methods.name: check_no_process_for_user
methods.description: Checks if there are no processes for the test user running.

methods.name: unset_up_test_user
methods.description: Removes the test user after testing.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Class setup for RPM install/remove tests, locating RPM files.

methods.name: test_check_rpm_install_removal_log_file_size
methods.description: Verifies RPM logs are written during repeated install/removal cycles.
